scenarios.title: Timeout and same-reference retry
scenarios.deterministicAssertion: Timeout becomes UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT; new reference rejected; original reference accepted.
limitations: In-memory state helpers; no upstream connection or payment execution.

scenarios.title: Consent expiry and local revocation
scenarios.deterministicAssertion: Expired and locally revoked consent denied; valid scoped consent accepted.
limitations: No signature verification, gateway database instrumentation, or distributed revocation latency measurement.

scenarios.title: Signature, single-byte tamper, and clock drift
scenarios.deterministicAssertion: Ephemeral-key signature verifies; one-byte mutation fails digest check; 420-second drift blocks public sync.
limitations: Ephemeral test keys only; no registrar identity, FIDO2 device, PDF parser, QR scanner, or sealing service verified.

scenarios.title: Zero-escrow validation
scenarios.deterministicAssertion: Valid zero-escrow fixture accepted; platform and state intermediary escrow independently rejected with 422.
limitations: Validation only; treasury account ownership and routing or settlement are not verified.

scenarios.title: Agent countersignature and escrow reversal
scenarios.deterministicAssertion: No GivePower gateway or x402 escrow implementation is available in this workspace.
limitations: Cannot execute human countersignature verification or upstream-503 escrow reversal.
